notes: The app now checks for updates once a day and can install them itself — you always see what changed and press Update before anything happens.
Busy blocks can repeat on any set of days (every day, weekdays, or just Mon/Wed/Fri) and stop on an optional end date.
Busy blocks can carry travel time either side, so school 8–3 with an hour's commute really blocks 7–4 and the auto-scheduler plans around the whole trip.
Click a busy block in the week view to edit it.
University: keep your own links on each course, and add, rename or remove your quick-launch portals.
Subjects: the target arrow is hidden once you're at or above your target — the grade badge turns green instead.
